description: Lengthens or shortens a gate under voltage control, and fires a trigger at the end of each gate it produces

params.text: Attenuverter for the CV input, -1 to +1, setting how far that input moves the gate length and in which direction
Sets the length added to the gate, reaching 1 second with the range set to FAST, 10 seconds at MED and 20 seconds at SLOW
Picks the full-scale gate length: FAST for up to 1 second, MED for up to 10 seconds, SLOW for up to 20 seconds
RETRIGGER holds the output high for as long as the input gate lasts plus the set length; ONE-SHOT holds the output high for the set length alone, whatever the input gate does

inputs.text: Modulates the gate length, scaled by the CV knob; the voltage is read over a range of -10V to +10V
The gate or trigger that starts the output gate; over 2V counts as high, and it counts as low again below 0.1V
A gate over 2V here cuts the output gate short and holds the output low until the next rising edge at TRIGGER

outputs.text: The modified gate, 10V while high and 0V while low
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the output gate ends

notes: to shorten a gate, choose ONE-SHOT and a length shorter than the incoming gate
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
